name: G4 Real-Task Work-Tree DeepSeek V4 Pro Node Tool Budget Live
suiteRoleNote: Single live experiment: use auto-unfinished revision targeting plus a node-local 5 toolcall soft budget prompt and warning to test whether the LLM leaves root/parent nodes and returns to parent orchestration.

cases.title: G4 Work-Tree DeepSeek V4 Pro Node Tool Budget: Grid Storage Research
cases.taskGoal: Use network search to compare at least four long-duration energy storage routes for 2030 grid balancing (Li-ion, sodium-ion, flow battery, and green hydrogen), then produce a recommendation for a mid-size grid operator under cost, safety, and deployment-speed constraints.
cases.currentObjective: Deliver a web-grounded comparison report while enforcing node-local workflow control and parent/leaf responsibility.

currentContext.title: decision scope
currentContext.content: Target operator profile: peak load 3-6 GW, renewable share 45%-60%, procurement horizon to 2030. Decision criteria must include levelized storage cost range, safety risk profile, supply-chain risk, and implementation lead time.

currentContext.title: node-local toolcall budget
currentContext.content: Each work-tree node has only 5 toolcall opportunities. If more concrete search/fetch/read/compute/edit work is needed, create or enter a child leaf before continuing. Entering a new node refreshes the 5 toolcall opportunities for that node. If a leaf has enough evidence, stop tool work in the leaf and return a handoff for parent evaluation.

currentContext.title: hard leaf example
currentContext.content: Example to follow: The parent/orchestrator decides that policy evidence is needed, then outputs only <work-node-create title="policy evidence leaf" questions="Which regulator or policy source constrains 2030 storage selection?" evidence="policy-source-url">Search regulator and policy sources for grid storage constraints.</work-node-create>. In the next window, while currentNodeId is that leaf, call tools. A leaf must not declare the whole task complete and must not produce the final report. When the leaf has enough evidence, it outputs only a leaf handoff: useful findings, evidence refs, discarded routes, gaps, and risks, then stops. The parent/orchestrator evaluates the child handoff, decides whether another leaf is needed, and only the parent/orchestrator may write the final report or declare task completion.

currentContext.title: delivery contract
currentContext.content: Tool execution is enabled. Build the report from verifiable web evidence. Include a source table and explicitly discuss at least one contradiction between sources and how it was resolved.

cases.responseRequirements: Use network search and deliver a complete comparison report in Markdown. Hard work-tree rule: concrete tool-backed work belongs in leaf nodes, and parent/orchestrator nodes do workflow control. Each work-tree node has only 5 toolcall opportunities. If the current node needs more than 5 toolcalls, do not keep calling tools in the same node: create or enter a child leaf, then stop the current window so the next window executes from that leaf. Entering a new node refreshes the 5 toolcall opportunities for that node. A leaf may call tools and synthesize local evidence, but a leaf must not declare the whole task complete and must not produce the final report. After a leaf has enough evidence, output only a leaf handoff for the parent: useful findings, evidence refs, discarded routes, gaps, and risks; then stop. The parent/orchestrator must evaluate each child handoff against the delivery contract, decide whether another leaf is needed, and only the parent/orchestrator may write the final Markdown report or declare task completion. Include: (1) comparison matrix across Li-ion, sodium-ion, flow battery, green hydrogen; (2) explicit contradiction analysis with resolution rationale; (3) source table with URL/domain/published date/key claim. Output Markdown only.
cases.restartMessage: Window restart: preserve the node-local toolcall budget and leaf-executes-parent-evaluates rule. If currentNodeId is root or a parent/orchestrator and concrete tool work is needed, create or enter a child leaf before using tools. If currentNodeId is a leaf, use at most 5 toolcalls in that leaf, output a leaf handoff, and stop. If currentNodeId is a parent/orchestrator and a child handoff is available, evaluate it against the delivery contract, choose the next leaf or final delivery, and only then declare task completion. Output Markdown only.
cases.toolResultReflectionReminder: Workflow control checkpoint: after each tool batch, count the current node's toolcalls and reassess whether the next action should continue this leaf, create/enter a child node, return to parent evaluation, or deliver.

workTreeNodeToolCallSoftLimit.warningMessage: 警告：当前工作树节点已经超过本节点的 5 次 toolcall 机会。你应该进行工作流程上的安排：如果还需要更多具体工具工作，创建或进入子节点；如果当前 leaf 已经完成，返回父节点评估、调度或收束。下次 toolcall 将被拒绝。

postCompletionActions.userMessage: 这个任务还不能结束。harness 应该从未完成的位置继续：如果当前节点仍有未完成子节点，就在当前节点继续安排；如果当前节点完成但 sibling 未完成，就回父节点继续调度。先做任务控制分析，然后继续执行，不要只解释原因。
postCompletionActions.resumeMessage: Revision after premature completion: first perform task-control analysis, then continue from the auto-selected unfinished work-tree position using node-local toolcall budget discipline.
postCompletionActions.currentObjective: Continue the unfinished work tree from the correct parent/leaf position, enforce the 5 toolcall per node workflow budget, and only deliver after all required storage routes and contradiction analysis are complete.
postCompletionActions.responseRequirements: First output a concise 'Task Control Analysis' section that identifies currentNodeId, unfinished child or sibling nodes, parent-vs-leaf responsibility, missing routes/evidence, and the next node/action. Then continue the unfinished work. Each node has only 5 toolcall opportunities; if more tool work is needed, create or enter a child leaf, or return to parent orchestration. Do not stop at explanation. Complete Li-ion, sodium-ion, flow battery, and green hydrogen coverage, contradiction analysis, source table, and final recommendation. Output Markdown only.
postCompletionActions.toolResultReflectionReminder: Workflow control checkpoint: after each tool batch, count the current node's toolcalls and reassess whether the next action should continue this leaf, create/enter a child node, return to parent evaluation, or deliver.
